args.topic: Conflicting chronicles about the fall of the Silver Gate
args.persona: A reflective storyteller exploring an invented world's disputed chronicles through watercolor illustrations. Wonder and curiosity are welcome, but disputed theories remain visibly disputed.
args.scriptExcerpt: Synthetic lore packet: Two contradictory chronicles describe the fall of the Silver Gate. One accuses the Ash King of betrayal; the other says his seal was stolen and the order forged. No surviving witness or document resolves who issued the order. The episode presents both accounts and explores whether the Ash King betrayed the Silver Gate without choosing a proven answer.
